product_one_liner.value: Eden provides radiology teams and health systems a cloud-native diagnostic operating system that combines PACS, RIS, imaging, and reporting workflows with AI-assisted study analysis and report drafting.
product_one_liner.notes: Eden describes its Diagnostic OS as a cloud-native replacement for PACS, RIS, viewing, and reporting tools, and says its AI analyzes studies and drafts reports before radiologists open cases.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index entries shown are healthcare/product explainers, marketing topics, and customer stories rather than engineers describing how Eden builds its product; no pair of qualifying build-focused posts appears in these index pages.

public_docs.notes: Eden’s public API documentation index links multiple substantive documentation pages covering orders, studies, appointments, and quotations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Eden jobs board lists an active Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model role.

model_provider.value: Eden's in-house Eden Creator language model and Eden Cortex transformer-based imaging model.
model_provider.notes: Eden publicly names Eden Creator as its language-intelligence model and describes Eden Cortex as a transformer-based medical-imaging model; these are Eden-branded models rather than a named external provider.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The active Eden jobs board lists one role, the AI Research foundation-model position, and no SDR, BDR, or account-executive/sales-development role.
